mootSayLines.text: They're named, every one: Rafael Khan. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Rafael nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
◈ The Records: You won The Moot under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud.
